title: feat(verify): the dashboard date-window family, runnable as os verify --dashboard-windows (#15953 slice 5)
body:
Part of #15953
Clause-②: yes

## What this is

Slice 5 of #15953: the D residue of the classification table's row 9 (`6115219467`), "every datetime-windowed dashboard answers under its own picker". hotcrm's `test/dashboard-date-range-window.test.ts` describe 2 pins that by hand for its Service dashboard. It is now a derived proof family in `@objectstack/verify` (the seventh, beside `runCrudVerification`), runnable as the opt-in `os verify --dashboard-windows`. Row 9's R half (describe 1, the datetime filter window per storage shape) stays where the table puts it, in the temporal-conformance matrix upstream; it is not in this PR. The card stays open for its remaining rows.

## The family (`packages/verify/src/dashboard-window.ts`)

**The property.** Every dashboard that declares a `dateRange` answers, under each preset of its own picker, with the rows that window selects. Per bound widget and count measure, three verdicts per preset: the widget is not blank where the window holds fixture rows; its count equals the rows the window selects; and a narrower preset never answers more than a wider one. A window that never narrows is named inert.

**Where each expectation is read from (published sources only, nothing re-derived):**

- The binding: `DashboardWidgetSchema.filterBindings` (`packages/spec/src/ui/dashboard.zod.ts`). A string binds the window to that field, `false` opts the widget out (`unbound`), and absent means the filter's own field, "dateRange: `dateRange.field ?? 'created_at'`". Dashboards and datasets are read through `DashboardSchema.safeParse` and `DatasetSchema.safeParse`. The field resolves against `dataset.object` as the booted stack registers it, so `created_at` (a registry-injected column) resolves. It must be `date` or `datetime`. The `created_at` literal has no export; it is named once with its source, beside the lint's own copy (`DATE_RANGE_DEFAULT_FIELD` in `validate-widget-bindings.ts`).
- A preset's window: `DATE_RANGE_PRESET_MACRO_WINDOWS` (`@objectstack/spec/data`), for each of the 13 `DATE_RANGE_PRESETS`. It is handed as written, `{ $gte: start, $lte: end }` (`end` absent for the three rolling presets), ANDed with the widget's own filter as `{ $and: [filter, window] }`, the shipped console's merge (objectui `mergeFilters`). The server resolves the tokens (`dataset-executor.ts` `resolveSelectionTokens`), and the verifier lowers nothing.
- The ground truth's day boundaries: the same window object, resolved by `@objectstack/core`'s `resolveFilterTokens` (the resolver the executor calls) on the caller's `ExecutionContext.timezone`, UTC when unset. Membership follows the table's own stated convention: first and last day inclusive, rolling end open.

**The door.** `POST {basePath}/analytics/dataset/query` with `datasetName` and the widget's own selection (its `dimensions`, one count measure, its filter with the window ANDed in as `runtimeFilter`), as the signed-in principal the caller passes in. `os verify` passes the dev admin from `signIn()`. Measured on `bootStack` at `21c86444ec`:

- the saved dataset resolves by name through the protocol's `getMetaItems({ type: 'dataset' })` (200), so nothing here waits on #23088;
- a plain sign-up member is refused `403 PERMISSION_DENIED` reading the object, so the admin is the principal;
- the admin's context reads `timezone: 'UTC'`.

hotcrm's file called `AnalyticsService.queryDataset` in process as `{ isSystem: true, userId: VIEWER }`; the family uses the HTTP door every dashboard request takes. `{current_user_id}` in a widget filter is that principal, and the server resolves it.

**Fixtures.**

- **Days.** One row per day across every preset's first and last day and the day either side, never after today: 20 days on 2026-10-13, from 2024-12-31 to today. Each row is stamped at UTC noon; a `date` field takes the day itself.
- **Door and shape.** Rows go through the seed door, which measurably keeps an explicit `created_at`. They are the smallest CRUD-derived record; if the seed door refuses that, every field the CRUD derivation synthesizes is used instead, and the report names which shape it took.
- **Owner and held columns.** Each row is owned by the principal (seeded rows carry no owner otherwise). Every column the widget's filter, the dataset's filter and the measure's filter compare is held to a value they select. Modelled: an equality, `$in` (its first member), `$nin` or `$ne` on a field that declares options (the first option not excluded, so no row is NULL there), `{current_user_id}`, and `$and` of these. Anything else is an exclusion with its reason, never a guess, as hotcrm's `truthMatches` throws.
- **Read-back.** Every row is read back before anything is judged. A stamp or held column that does not read back as written (an app hook rewrote it) makes the probe not run, never contradicted. So does a column the read omits (`internal: true`), named as unconfirmed rather than rewritten.

**The comparison.** Every count is a difference: the count after the fixtures minus the count before, under the same window, so the app's own rows cancel. The control leg is the widget with no window: it must count every fixture row, or the fixtures do not meet the widget's own selection and no window is judged. A count of a named field gets a non-null value held. An average, a sum or a derived measure is excluded and counted.

**Statuses.** `proven`, `contradicted` (blank, or another count), `failed` (the windowed query refused or faulted while the unwindowed one answered), `inconclusive`, `unbound`, `excluded` (with `excludedKind`). `hardFailures` = `contradicted + failed` widgets.

## Controls and ablations

- **NEGATIVE CONTROL, drop** (`dashboard-window.test.ts`): the app's own plugin registers an aggregate middleware on the object, through the engine's published seam (`registerMiddleware`, `ctx.operation === 'aggregate'`, `ctx.ast.where`, the seam the engine's own refusal text prescribes for read filters). It removes the window's condition, so the floor matches every row, the #3912 class. Found: every preset contradicted ("the window counted 20 fixture row(s), and it selects N (wider)"), named inert, `hardFailures` 1. No engine source was changed.
- **NEGATIVE CONTROL, zero:** the same seam, making a windowed query match nothing. Found: every preset `blank`.
- **ATTRIBUTION CONTROL:** an app hook stamping the window's field on insert reads back as rewritten, so the probe does not run and the widget is `inconclusive`, never contradicted. An `internal: true` window field reads back "no audited_at (the read does not return that field)", unconfirmed.
- **CLI:** `packages/cli/test/verify-dashboard-windows.test.ts` spawns `os verify`. Without the flag there is no `dashboardWindows` key and exit 0. With it, the widget is proven under 13 presets and the run exits 0. On the same app plus the drop plugin, the widget is contradicted and inert, `hardFailures` 1, exit 1.
- **ABLATIONS of the family's own comparison** (`judge`): `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, inside a scratch script with `trap restore EXIT INT TERM` on absolute paths, at `3228b5954b`. No build is involved: the test imports the module by a relative path.
  - **A:** `if (answered === expected) return { outcome: 'held', ... }` becomes an unconditional `held` plus `ABLATION_15953_S5_A`. Anchor 1 → 0, marker 0 → 1, blob `36251c04` → `ff99b96d`. RED: `Tests 2 failed | 8 passed (10)`, the drop control and its summary line, as predicted. Restored: blob `36251c04` equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
  - **B:** the `blank` branch becomes `if (false)` plus `ABLATION_15953_S5_B`. Anchor 1 → 0, blob `36251c04` → `58ef1cfa`. RED: `Tests 1 failed | 9 passed (10)`, exactly the zero control, as predicted. Restored to HEAD's blob, empty diff.

## First consumer: hotcrm

hotcrm read-only clone, fetched: `main` at `0f84c9c7`. The test file, every dashboard and every dataset are unchanged since `1d7148bf`; `case.object.ts` changed a comment only, and `account.object.ts` lost one select `defaultValue` that no windowed widget reads. The runs use slice 3's artifact at `1d7148bf` (built by hotcrm's own CLI 17.7.0) and its `os migrate meta --from 17` snapshot. `engines.protocol` was moved to `^18` and the 76 `email_template.category` tombstones were removed in memory, as slices 3-4 did. Nothing was written to hotcrm. `os verify` still cannot boot hotcrm (protocol `^17.7.0` against this tree's 18), so the family ran directly over the artifact.

Population: 5 dashboards, 4 windowed. Those 4 carry 49 widgets: 21 unbound, 13 excluded (all `no-count-measure`: sums, averages and derived ratios), and 15 probed. All 15 probed widgets are count widgets over `crm_case.created_at` (datetime) and `crm_opportunity.close_date` (date); 5 non-count measures beside them are excluded. That makes 195 windows per run.

| run | engine | hooks | proven | contradicted | inconclusive | windows held / not run |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| C | this tree | without bodies | 15 | 0 | 0 | 195 / 0 |
| B | this tree | the artifact's 44 bodies grafted | 12 | 0 | 3 | 156 / 39 |
| A | hotcrm's pinned `@objectstack/verify` 17.7.0 `bootStack`, the artifact as built | live | 12 | 0 | 3 | 156 / 39 |

In every run: 0 blank, 0 inert, 0 narrowing violations. The 3 inconclusives in A and B are `kb_resolved_cases`, `closed_cases_total` and `top_resolving_articles`: hotcrm's own hook derives `is_closed` from `status`, so a held `is_closed: true` reads back `false`. The attribution control is doing its job on a real app. `won_deals` meets hotcrm's "Win Reason is required" rule only with the every-field shape.

**Against describe 2** (`service_dashboard`, run C; runs A and B agree wherever their fixtures read back):

- "is exercising at least one dashboard": `service_dashboard` is windowed on `created_at`, and so are 3 more dashboards the file never covered (on `close_date`, a `date` field).
- "leaves no widget blank at last_7/30/90_days": 0 blank over all 13 presets for its 10 bound count widgets. The file's blank check also covered three non-count widgets (`avg_resolution_time`, `sla_compliance_gauge`, `kb_deflection_rate`); the family excludes those and counts them.
- "counts exactly the rows the window selects": every `case_count` widget the file compared holds under all 13 presets: `open_cases`, `critical_cases`, `sla_violations`, `cases_by_status`, `cases_by_priority`, `cases_by_origin`, `my_open_cases_by_priority` (its `{current_user_id}` filter is the principal). So do `closed_cases_total`, `kb_resolved_cases` and `top_resolving_articles`, which the file did not count.
- "narrows as the preset narrows" (`cases_by_origin`): 1 / 1 / 2 / 3 / 7 / 4 / 7 / 8 / 17 / 2 / 4 / 9 / 13 fixture rows over the 13 presets, the unwindowed 20 of 20, not inert, no nested pair answering more.
- `daily_case_volume` is `unbound`; the file ran it with no window.

0 contradictions with what describe 2 asserted.

## Verification

All at `3228b5954b`, the merge of `origin/main` `0d43004100`, after `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` and `turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/cli...` (60 tasks), then `--filter=!@objectstack/docs` (74 tasks). Each run went through `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`, and each reads `VERDICT command-exit 0`.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/verify exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2`: `Test Files 37 passed (37)`, `Tests 299 passed (299)`. `dashboard-window.test.ts` alone: `Tests 10 passed (10)`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/verify typecheck && pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli typecheck`: `check:test-typecheck: OK` for both. With `tsc --listFilesOnly -p tsconfig.test.json`, `dashboard-window` is in verify's program (2 hits) and `verify-dashboard-windows` in cli's (1 hit).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project integration --maxWorkers=2` over the eight `test/verify-*.test.ts` files: `Test Files 8 passed (8)`, `Tests 24 passed (24)`. The rest of the integration tier is declared to CI.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project unit --maxWorkers=2`: `Test Files 285 passed (285)`, `Tests 4283 passed (4283)`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/core exec vitest run --project repo --maxWorkers=2`: `Test Files 6 passed (6)`, `Tests 83 passed (83)`. The #22661 pin `second-object-read-exposure.pin.test.ts` is among them, with no `CALLERS` row needed: the family never calls `referenceTargetOf`.
- `pnpm check:verify-stand-in` exited 1 before the two `NOT_A_STAND_IN` rows (`2 problem(s)`: `runDashboardWindowProofs`, `formatDashboardWindowReport`) and exits 0 after (`2 stand-in check(s) guarded, 17 candidate(s) explicitly exempt, 10 call site(s) reached`).
- **Gates:** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` with no paths derived 115 commands, the same 115 as over this PR's 9 paths. 115 run, all exit 0, and `--ran` reports `115 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 115 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED`. Three of them (`spec check:skill-examples`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:i18n-coverage`) first answered exit 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET, and were measured after the 74-task build.
- **Lint, as a proven narrowing:** `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` over the 6 touched source files reads 6 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings, counted from the JSON. Population: `--print-config` resolves a config for all 6; the three Markdown files answer "File ignored because no matching configuration was supplied". Invariance: `eslint.config.mjs` never enables type-aware linting (its comment at about `:327`; no `parserOptions.project`), so this diff cannot move an untouched file's verdict.
- hotcrm runs B and C re-taken at `3228b5954b`: the same counts as the table above.

## Acceptance notes

- The shipped console closes the three rolling presets at `{today}` (objectui `dashboard-filters` `PRESET_RANGES`, at the `.objectui-sha` pin `7578323a`), while the spec's `DATE_RANGE_PRESET_MACRO_WINDOWS` leaves them open. The fixtures carry no day after today and the differential cancels every other row, so the verdict is the same under either; the README and `cli.mdx` say so.
- `created_at` as the built-in date range's default field lives as a literal in the lint, in objectui and now here; no spec export carries it.
- The fixture helpers (`fixtureBody`, `vary`, `laterBy`, `uniqueFields`) are now copied in four family modules, each module-private, as slice 4's record noted; a shared one belongs in `derive.ts`, outside this claim.
- The family measures count widgets only. A widget whose only measures are a sum, an average or a derived ratio is excluded and counted.

## Deviations

- **The window handed to the door is the spec's `DATE_RANGE_PRESET_MACRO_WINDOWS`, not hotcrm's `{ $gte: '{N_days_ago}', $lte: '{today}' }`.** That pair is the console's own lowering (objectui `PRESET_RANGES`), a table in the sibling repo; copying it here would be a fourth copy of the vocabulary `date-range-presets.ts` was consolidated to end. The spec's table is the in-repo statement of each preset's window. The analytics door's own preset arm (`timeDimensions[].dateRange`, lowered by core's `resolveAnalyticsDateRangePreset`) was not used: it needs a dataset dimension, while a dashboard window binds an object field.
- **The principal is the dev admin.** A plain member is refused `403` reading the object, so the family takes the caller's token (`os verify` passes `signIn()`'s), as the CRUD, reference-shape, delete-behaviour and unique-scope families do. Fixture rows are owned by it.
- **Fixtures are written per widget and count measure, and every count is a difference.** The window field is the probe, and the app's own rows cancel out, so no measurement depends on the stack being empty. The unwindowed control leg is what makes a fixture that misses the widget's selection read `inconclusive`, never contradicted.
- **The negative controls are an app plugin's aggregate middleware** (the engine's published seam), which `bootStack` and `os serve` compose identically, so the same control runs from the spawned CLI.
- **`$nin` / `$ne` are held** only on a field that declares options (the first option not excluded). Without that, five of hotcrm's opportunity count widgets would be excluded.
- **A refused smallest record is retried once with every synthesized field.** It is pinned by a fixture hook; on hotcrm, `won_deals` needs it.
- **hotcrm evidence comes from direct runs of the family**, as slices 1-4 did (protocol `^17.7.0` against 18). The 76 `email_template.category` tombstones were removed in memory.
- **`origin/main` was merged once**, at `0d43004100`, and the build was refreshed; one conflict in `cli.mdx`, beside #23093's new sentence, was resolved keeping both. `main` then moved 6 more commits, to `d206d08cab`, none on this PR's files. One, `f931e765b7`, refines `DashboardHeaderActionSchema.actionUrl`, which the family's dashboard parse reads; hotcrm's dashboards declare no header actions, so its counts cannot move. #23088 had not landed at either reading, so there is one composition, and both runs are on it.
- Commits carry the model-free trailer pair, as AGENTS.md says, and this body ends with its session-URL footer.
